# Theory: Notifications Observe the Loop; Secrets Must Not Live as Plain Desired State

Slack fires on Application events. Secrets need an external system (Sealed Secrets, SOPS, ESO) so Git stays the *index* of secret *references*. Blue-green at the Argo CD layer is usually two apps or a Rollouts object.

## Invariants

1. Notification config is itself desired state (or a cluster controller).
2. Sealed/SOPS ciphertext can live in Git; plaintext must not.
3. Blue-green without Rollouts is two Destinations or two services.

```text
Application event → notification controller → Slack
Git ciphertext    → controller           → cluster Secret
```

## What can break

- Base64 secrets in Git called ‘encryption’.

## How to read this chapter

Slack, secret strategies, blue-green.
